race.title: Pat Carroll's Pub Kilkenny Mares Handicap Hurdle (0-100) (Div 1)
race.verdict: Not as competitive as the numbers suggest and it could pay to side with KATE KNOWS BEST who should strip sharper for her recent Sligo fifth after an absence and can now capitalise on a handy-looking mark. A Snow White Park completed a hat-trick over fences at Clonmel two days ago and rates a major threat if translating that form back to hurdles. In-form maiden Demanding Gerry and the lightly-raced Lady Fromentro appeal as the pick of the rest. KATE KNOWS BEST (IRE) A SNOW WHITE PARK (IRE) DEMANDING GERRY (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: A Snow White Park (1/1), Demanding Gerry (9/2), Albatala (7/1), Lady Fromentro (10/1), Doyen Og (12/1), Kate Knows Best (14/1), Grace's Legacy (16/1), Avandra (20/1), Certosa (20/1), Bearami Creek (20/1), Good Bye Milan (25/1), Glory Sky (25/1), On A Diamond (50/1), Pixie Hill (50/1), The Chancie Grey (50/1)
